title: Immunohistochemical Staining of Heparanase in Human Pancreas Islets
author: Lora Starrs
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kv4cw8w

steps.title: Deparaffinize and rehydrate slides
steps.instruction: Deparaffinize slides in xylene for 1 min per change. Rehydrate through graded alcohols: dip 10 times in absolute ethanol (container of absolute ethanol), then 10 dips in 90 % ethanol, then 10 dips in 70 % ethanol. Wash well in running tap water for 5 min.

steps.title: Encircle sections and rinse
steps.instruction: Wipe around sections with a tissue, encircle each section with a diamond pencil, and place the slides in a slide container containing 250 ml tap water.

steps.title: Block endogenous peroxidase
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in 3 % hydrogen peroxide in methanol (prepare 250 ml solution by mixing 25 ml 30 % H₂O₂ with 225 ml methanol).

steps.title: Wash after peroxidase block
steps.instruction: Wash slides 2 × 2 min in 250 ml phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS), then wash in running tap water for 5 min.

steps.title: Prepare citrate antigen‑retrieval buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.05 g citric acid in 500 ml deionized water, adjust pH to 6.0 with 2–10 M NaOH.

steps.title: Antigen retrieval in citrate buffer
steps.instruction: Transfer slides to 250 ml citrate buffer and heat in a 1600 W microwave: 2 min on high power, then 2 × 6 min on low power. Allow slides to cool on the bench for 30 min. Wash slides in 250 ml PBS 3 × 10 min.

steps.title: Block non‑specific Ig binding
steps.instruction: Wipe around sections with tissue, apply M.O.M. diluent to each section, and incubate 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Apply primary antibody
steps.instruction: Tip off excess block, wipe around sections, and incubate with 340 µg ml⁻¹ HP130 anti‑Hpse monoclonal antibody (or 350 µg ml⁻¹ mouse IgG1κ isotype control) diluted in M.O.M. diluent, using 125–150 µl per section, at room temperature for 30 min. (Alternative: 228 µg ml⁻¹ HPA1 rabbit anti‑human heparanase IgG or 227 µg ml⁻¹ rabbit IgG isotype control).

steps.title: Wash off primary antibody
steps.instruction: Wash slides with PBS, transfer to a slide container containing 250 ml PBS, and wash 2 × 2 min.

steps.title: Apply secondary biotinylated antibody
steps.instruction: Wipe around sections, incubate with 1/250 diluted secondary biotinylated anti‑mouse IgG (M.O.M. immunodetection kit), 150 µl per section, for 10 min at room temperature. (Alternative: 37 µg ml⁻¹ HRP‑swine anti‑rabbit Ig).

steps.title: Wash off secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Wash slides with PBS, transfer to a slide container with 250 ml PBS, and wash 2 × 2 min.

steps.title: Apply ABC reagent
steps.instruction: Wipe around sections, cover with Vectastain ABC reagent (M.O.M. immunodetection kit), and incubate 5 min at room temperature. (Alternative: omit this step if HPA1 anti‑heparanase polyclonal antibody is used).

steps.title: Wash off ABC reagent
steps.instruction: Wash slides with PBS, transfer to a slide container containing 250 ml PBS, and wash 3 × 10 min. (Alternative: omit this step if HPA1 anti‑heparanase polyclonal antibody is used).

steps.title: Prepare AEC chromogen solution
steps.instruction: Mix 4.75 ml acetate buffer, 0.25 ml AEC stock solution, and 25 µl 3 % H₂O₂. Filter through a disposable 0.2 µm filter. Use within 2 h of preparation, store short‑term on ice, and protect from light.

steps.title: Develop with AEC
steps.instruction: Wipe around sections, cover them with the AEC solution, and incubate 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash off AEC solution
steps.instruction: Wash slides with deionized water, transfer to a slide container containing 250 ml deionized water, and wash 3 × 10 min.

steps.title: Counterstain and mount
steps.instruction: Lightly counterstain with Mayer’s hematoxylin, wash in deionized water 2 ×, briefly dip in ammonium water (100 µl ammonia in 250 ml deionized water) 2 × 2 sec, wash again in deionized water 2 ×  (250 ml each), and coverslip using Glycergel mounting medium.

steps.title: Capture images
steps.instruction: Photograph the stained sections using a light microscope equipped with a camera attachment.
